utils.activations module

class utils.activations.SwiGLU(*args, **kwargs)

Bases: Module

SwiGLU activation function module.

This module splits the input tensor into two halves along the last dimension, applies the SiLU activation function to the second half, and then multiplies the two halves element-wise.

forward(x)

Applies the SwiGLU activation function to the input tensor.

Applies the SwiGLU activation function to the input tensor.

Parameters:

x (torch.Tensor) – Input tensor of shape (N, *, 2*C) where * means any number of additional dimensions.

Returns:

Output tensor of shape (N, *, C).

Return type:

torch.Tensor

class utils.activations.Swish

Bases: Module

Swish activation function module.

This module applies the Swish activation function, which is defined as x * sigmoid(beta * x), where beta is a learnable parameter.

beta

Learnable parameter for the Swish activation function.

Type:

torch.nn.Parameter

forward(x)

Applies the Swish activation function to the input tensor.

Applies the Swish activation function to the input tensor.

Parameters:

x (torch.Tensor) – Input tensor.

Returns:

Output tensor after applying the Swish activation function.

Return type:

torch.Tensor

utils.activations.get_activation_fn(activation: str)

Returns the activation function module based on the given activation name.

Parameters:

activation (str) – Name of the activation function. Supported values are “relu”, “gelu”, “swish”, “swiglu”, “silu”, and “elu”.

Returns:

Activation function module.

Return type:

torch.nn.Module

Raises:

RuntimeError – If the given activation function name is not supported.
